clauses.heading: Services
clauses.text: The Carrier shall collect, transport and deliver the Customer's goods between the Customer's warehouses and retail outlets as set out in Schedule 1.

clauses.heading: Loading access
clauses.text: The Customer shall ensure that its warehouse staff are available twenty-four (24) hours a day, seven (7) days a week, including between 21:00 and 06:00, to load and unload the Carrier's vehicles.

clauses.heading: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Customer shall pay each invoice within ten (10) days of the invoice date.

clauses.heading: Late payment
clauses.text: Overdue amounts shall bear a penalty of two percent (2%) per day until paid in full, without limit.

clauses.heading: Liability of the Carrier
clauses.text: The Carrier's total liability for loss of or damage to goods shall not exceed AZN 5,000 per calendar year.

clauses.heading: Liability of the Customer
clauses.text: The Customer shall indemnify the Carrier against all losses arising from the Customer's breach, and the Customer's liability shall be unlimited.

clauses.heading: Term and renewal
clauses.text: This Agreement runs until 31 December 2026 and shall renew automatically for successive periods of twenty-four (24) months unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least one hundred and twenty (120) days before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: The Customer may terminate this Agreement only for the Carrier's material breach that remains unremedied for ninety (90) days.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information confidential for three (3) years after termination of this Agreement.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales and the courts of London shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
